claim.value: Time-to-completion estimates should include unfinished exports.
claim.scope: Proposed completion-time estimation; no estimator is specified.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly requires including unfinished exports in time-to-completion estimates without specifying an estimator.

signal_basis.value: Follow exposed exports to completion where feasible, explicitly censor those still unfinished, and include unfinished exports when estimating time to completion.
signal_basis.scope: Proposed follow-up and estimation for exports exposed to the experiment; measurements are not yet reported.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the follow-up procedure, explicit censoring, inclusion requirement, and prospective measurement status.
The bounded inclusion requirement is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Unfinished exports provide information that completion time exceeds their observed follow-up. Excluding them would preferentially omit slower exports. Including their censored observations is therefore warranted for completion-time estimation.
uncertainty: No estimator or censoring assumptions are specified, so this does not establish unbiasedness, precision, or identification of the full completion-time distribution.
